description: This file defines a React component 'UsageViewSelect' along with related types and data structures. It provides a user interface element for selecting different usage views, such as global, organization, team, etc., each with associated icons, descriptions, and some admin-only options.

methods.name: getFilteredOptions
methods.description: Filters and formats the OPTIONS array based on the isAdmin prop to determine which options are visible, and adjusts labels and descriptions accordingly.
